evidence: A user installed Plasma Bigscreen on a cheap mini-HTPC, used KDE Connect as a phone remote, and found it easier and preferable to Android TV.

evidence_sources.author: brnt
evidence_sources.excerpt: A week ago I bought a cheap mini-htpc and put Plasma Bigscreen on it, using a phone with KDEconnect as remote. So easy to use! So much better than AndroidTV let alone proprietary crap.
